experiments.focal_definition: [10*y*(1-sigmoid(z))^2*softplus(-z) + (1-y)*sigmoid(z)^2*softplus(z)] averaged over valid pixels; equivalent to alpha10/11 scaled by11
experiments.causal_scope: loss-family change including removal of Dice; not proof that focusing alone causes any difference
experiments.optional_mechanism_control: separate later proposal: 0.5*focal(gamma2)+0.5*same Dice versus 0.5*focal(gamma0)+0.5*same Dice; gamma0 equals historical weighted BCE; not part of the one-run first experiment
